title: Ecosystem partner daily journal — quick handoffs & TODOs
content:
2026-03-13 (Fri) — quick log / brain dump

Morning: sync w/ Liam 09:30 — high-level partner readiness for VectorLabs demo.
Notes: they want a 15-min live demo + 20-min Q&A. Need to scope sample dataset size (<=10k tokens).

Top priorities (TODAY):
- [ ] Finalize demo script + 3 prompts (Ravi to review by 12:00)
- [ ] Provision partner test API key (use staging org: marketplace-veclab-stg) — blocked by infra ticket? follow up with Infra SRE (ticket INF-289).
- [ ] Send NDA copy to legal / confirm addendum for data retention (reminder: use standard template but add clause for ephemeral logs)
- [ ] Create short test prompt set (5 prompts) in gist and link in JT slack channel

Quick checklist for integration readiness (scratch):
- integration docs: link + confirm model variant list (gpt-like open models + redwood-optimized variants)
- example payloads: streaming vs non-streaming behavior note — stream for demo to show latency improvements
- embeddings flow: confirm that partner expects vector search + reranking OR just embeddings export
- rate limits: ask product: what default rate limit for marketplace partners? (falls back to hosted default?)
- metrics to show in demo: p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens, token split (prompt/response)

Snippets / commands to remember:
- curl example (staging):
  curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer STAGE-XXXXX' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v1","input":"Write a short job description for a machine learning engineer"}'
  (note: escape json in actual scripts)

Slack refs / follow-ups:
- Ping @rachel-legal about NDA addendum (thread: #partners-legal, Feb thread id: 4512)
- DM @sre-infra to check INF-289 status — ask if we can temporarily whitelist partner QA IPs for demo window (Mar 16 14:00 PT)
- Post demo prep checklist in #marketplace-handoff channel before EOD

Risks / unknowns (notes to self):
- VectorLabs may require private deployment for PII dataset demo — need to estimate extra lead time (2–3 weeks). Flag to AE if they push for private.
- Billing model expectations unclear — some partners expect flat monthly vs usage-based. Add a short slide to demo to set expectations.

Action log (quick):
- 2026-03-09 created initial outreach doc (Aisha)
- 2026-03-11 call w/ VectorLabs (Ravi took notes) — summary: want low latency, embeddings for search, and a way to monitor quality drifts
- 2026-03-12 internal sync: choose redwood-7b-v1 for demo, fallback to redwood-3b-quant if capacity constrained

Small TODO bucket (personal):
- tidy up demo slides (slide 3: replace generic perf graph with our p50/p95 from last 72h)
- write 3 user stories to anchor the demo (search accuracy, latency-sensitive chat, reranking pipeline)
- quick smoke test of staging endpoint with sample dataset (2-3 queries)

Meeting prep for Monday (Mar 16):
- objectives: confirm scope, agree success metrics for POC (SLA target, cost threshold)
- attendees to confirm: AE, VectorLabs technical lead, infra SRE (optional), product PM
- prep items to send tonight: agenda, short prompt set, staging api key instructions, success criteria doc

Random notes / sticky items:
- Remember: for marketplace partners, emphasize "predictable inference economics" — show batching/caching option slide and rough % cost savings
- Ask product if we can expose a simplified dashboard view for partner (token breakdown + error rate) — if not, propose quick mock

Questions to resolve (dirty list):
1) Who signs partner MSA for partners under $X ARR? (Rachel Legal)
2) Can we create time-limited API keys scoped to a single model in staging? (SRE)
3) Do we have a marketplace-specific SLA template or use Dedicated SLA? (Sales + Prod Ops)

End-of-day micro-reflection:
- Made progress on demo script (first draft done). Still blocked on API key provisioning and NDA wording. Keep pressure on infra/legal via short reminders.

---

Notes-to-self (format loose):
- If partner asks about quantization artifacts, call out tradeoffs: memory vs quality; show example where 4-bit quantized model drops rare entity recall
- Quick benchmark note: previous tenant (AcmeRetail) saw p95 improve 30% with KV cache enabled for short convo flows — good anecdote for demo
- Keep the demo under 12 minutes production + 8 minutes Q&A so we stay crisp

End.
